purpose: Behavior-preserving instrumentation: output, selected-index, and RNG parity with the unchanged generator, plus newly observable root-search accounting. No wordlikeness improvement is claimed.
fingerprintMethod: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(generator.sources), containing sorted source paths and complete source text.
historicalArchives: Not compared. Archives captured before root-only length selection (#305) record different outputs, so the unchanged-generator rerun is the parity reference.

comparisonUnits.proposedLengths: All root attempts, before any planned affixes are attached.
comparisonUnits.selectedLengths: One returned word per search, including attached affixes.
comparisonUnits.strata: Actual morphology template and returned-word syllable count; proposed roots are grouped by the final returned result. Compare proposed and selected lengths directly only in bare strata.
